units.role: amplifier 1 (channel 1): IN1+ pin 3 noninverting input, IN1– pin 2 inverting input, OUT1 pin 1 output (TI SBOS839N Rev. N p8 Table 5-5, SOIC/TSSOP column)
identity_features: op-amp triangle (base x -4.445, half height 4.445, tip x +4.445) inside a 25.4 x 10.16 mm box: IN1+ pin 3 at (-17.78, +2.54) and IN1– pin 2 at (-17.78, -2.54) on the left, OUT1 pin 1 at (+17.78, 0) on the tip row; leads run from the input rows into the base corners and from the tip to OUT1 (Table 5-5 rows 3/2/1; grafts G1, G2 from flow-first)
drawn 1.27 mm polarity marks: '+' on the IN1+ row, a bar on the IN1– row; pin names carry U+2013 as Table 5-5 prints them (lead decision D-15); inputs typed input, the output output
'RRIO' inside the triangle at (-0.762, 0) (SBOS839N p1 'Rail-to-rail input and output')
bold unit title TLV9064IPWR equal to Value (graft G4), so a placed unit prints the part number once; ki_locked (units not interchangeable: unit 5 is the supply, not a fifth amplifier)
